source_row.rationale: Base excess (or base deficit, when negative) reflects the metabolic component of acid-base balance. A significantly negative base excess (base deficit) suggests a metabolic acidosis component, indicating a relative deficit of buffering base, often seen in conditions such as lactic acidosis, DKA, or renal failure.
source_row.source_detail: ABG components: base excess/deficit reflects relative excess or deficit of base and contributes to metabolic acid-base interpretation; updated 2026; accessed 2026-08-14.
